yearSpecificRule: If yearSpecific is false, year is null and the event recurs every year on the given day and month. If yearSpecific is true, the event applies only to the specified year.
notes: Dates of Islamic festivals can vary by moon sighting.
Dates of lunar Hindu festivals can vary by regional calendar and observance.
This dataset focuses on major Indian, West Bengal-relevant, educational, international and institutional occasions rather than every religious observance.
